statusSemantics.implementationStatus: Records implementation independently of evidence. NOT IMPLEMENTED is also a required backlog classification.
statusSemantics.verificationStatus: Best verified tier for the identified evidence scope, or null where no such tier applies. NATIVE CLIENT VERIFIED may refer to an explicitly bounded historical observation only.
statusSemantics.verifiedSourceRevision: Reference into sourceRevisions. Null means this backlog requirement has no verifying source revision. Supporting component tests on a pending E2E row do not certify the end-to-end scenario.
